title.en: Comments and transcripts, ready for your recap
title.zh: 把留言與字幕，整理成有來源的回顧

description.en: Find the original comments, work with your AI assistant on a recap, and keep a draft with citations. Try the local example without an account.
description.zh: 找到原始留言，與你的 AI 助理一起寫回顧，再把草稿與引用一起留下。先跑本地範例，不需要帳號。

eyebrow.zh: 從下一份活動回顧開始

headline.en: Turn comments into a recap with sources.
headline.zh: 把留言與字幕，整理成有來源的回顧。

lede.en: Have event feedback to review or a transcript to quote? Your AI assistant helps you make sense of it. MetaMuse keeps the originals, finds matching passages, and saves your draft with its citations.
lede.zh: 活動後的留言想整理？影片裡的一段話想引用？讓你慣用的 AI 助理幫忙判讀與撰寫，MetaMuse 負責保存原文、搜尋段落，把草稿與引用一起留下。

label.en: Read the getting started guide (中文)

notes.en: No account needed for the example

meta.zh: 合成資料示範 · 預寫回顧

label.en: Import a post and two comments
label.zh: 匯入一則貼文與兩則留言

label.en: Find the request for video subtitles
label.zh: 找到「希望影片加上字幕」的留言

label.en: Keep the original comment as a citation
label.zh: 保留原始留言作為引用

label.en: Open the recap as a Markdown file
label.zh: 打開 Markdown，閱讀回顧與來源

right.en: No AI call in this example

title.en: The event is over. The feedback is still scattered.
title.zh: 活動結束了，留言與影片還散在各處。

body.en: You want to know what people asked for, find a useful quote, and write a recap you can stand behind. Give your assistant permitted comments or local subtitles. MetaMuse keeps those sources available so you can check a draft against the original words.
body.zh: 想知道大家提了哪些需求、找出一段值得引用的話，再寫成一份能核對的回顧。把你有權使用的留言或本地字幕交給助理整理，MetaMuse 留下來源，讓你隨時回頭確認原文。

title.en: Less hunting for the original. More time for the recap.
title.zh: 少一點翻找原文，多一點時間整理重點。

intro.en: Start with local files. Add an assistant when you want help interpreting and writing.
intro.zh: 先從本地檔案開始，需要判讀與撰寫時，再交給你的 AI 助理協助。

body.en: Find comments about the next event, accessibility requests or missing materials. Your assistant can turn the selected evidence into a recap.
body.zh: 找出對下一場活動的建議、無障礙需求或索取講義的留言，再讓助理依選好的原文寫回顧。

body.en: Import local SRT or VTT files and search for the words you want to quote.
body.zh: 匯入本地 SRT 或 VTT 字幕，用關鍵字找出想引用的段落。

title.en: Check where a claim came from

body.en: Keep source references and exact text revisions alongside a draft, so you can compare the wording with the original.
body.zh: 將來源引用與原文版本連同草稿保存，需要時可以對照文字。

title.zh: 接上慣用的 AI 助理

body.en: Connect through CLI or MCP. The assistant asks questions and writes; MetaMuse handles the local records.
body.zh: 透過 CLI 或 MCP 連接。助理負責提問與撰寫，MetaMuse 負責保存本地資料。

body.en: Muse needs separate setup and approval. Two real turns succeeded across candidate builds; use 0.1.0a2 or later for the tested fixes.
body.zh: Muse 需要另外設定與授權。修正版已完成兩輪真實問答；請使用包含修正的 0.1.0a2 或後續版本。

title.en: Keep a file you can use
title.zh: 留下能接著使用的文件

body.en: Export Markdown, text, CSV, JSONL or a bundle for your own review and editing. Facebook Page text publishing is experimental and requires separate setup and your exact approval.
body.zh: 匯出 Markdown、文字、CSV、JSONL 或資料套件，方便後續閱讀與編輯。Facebook 粉專文字發文仍在實驗階段，需要另外設定，並由你核對批准。

title.en: Search, draft, export. In the real CLI.
title.zh: 搜尋、草稿、匯出，實際畫面在這裡。

intro.en: These are real terminal captures from a separate synthetic walkthrough, including fixture Muse replies. Each image links to a readable transcript. They demonstrate the workflow, not real-account results.
intro.zh: 這些是真實終端機截圖，來自另一份包含 fixture Muse 回覆的合成資料範例。每張都有純文字紀錄可閱讀，用來展示流程，不代表真實帳號的執行結果。

alt.en: Search hit with an exact item revision, Chinese snippet and source labels.
alt.zh: 搜尋命中包含精確項目版本、中文片段與來源標籤。

caption.en: One hit cites its exact item revision. Its source labels remain file_import and synthetic_fixture. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 一筆命中引用精確項目版本。來源標籤維持 file_import 與 synthetic_fixture。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Host-written draft citing the item and two Muse observations
alt.zh: 主代理草稿引用項目與兩筆 Muse 觀察

caption.en: The host saves its own text with the item revision and observations from both fixture exchanges. No generation call. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 主代理保存自行撰寫的文字，引用項目版本與兩輪 fixture 討論的觀察。沒有呼叫生成模型。閱讀純文字紀錄。

alt.en: Local bundle manifest, fixture labels and no-publication warnings
alt.zh: 本地套件清單、fixture 標記與未發布警告

caption.en: The local bundle manifest lists file hashes and retains the fixture labels. Stderr says nothing was published or uploaded, and redaction is a guard. Read transcript.
caption.zh: 本地套件清單列出檔案雜湊並保留 fixture 標記。stderr 寫明沒有發布或上傳，遮蔽只是一道防護。閱讀純文字紀錄。

title.en: Your assistant writes. You can check the sources.
title.zh: 助理幫你寫，你查得到來源。

intro.en: Install MetaMuse locally, then give an assistant access through CLI or MCP. The Skill explains how to use the connected tools.
intro.zh: 先在本地安裝 MetaMuse，再讓助理透過 CLI 或 MCP 使用工具。Skill 提供已連接工具的操作說明。

title.zh: 幾個你可能想問的問題。

intro.en: The first example uses local synthetic files, so you can see the result before connecting accounts or an assistant.
intro.zh: 第一個範例只用本地合成檔案，先看到結果，再決定是否連接帳號或 AI 助理。

title.en: Do I need a Muse account?
title.zh: 一定要有 Muse 帳號嗎？

body.en: No account is needed for local import, search, drafts or exports. Muse is a separately configured, optional discussion partner.
body.zh: 本地匯入、搜尋、草稿與匯出不需要帳號。Muse 是需要另外設定的選用討論對象。

title.en: Will the example write with AI?
title.zh: 範例會直接用 AI 寫回顧嗎？

body.en: It saves a clearly labelled prewritten recap. For your own work, connect an AI assistant or provide the text yourself.
body.zh: 範例保存的是清楚標記的預寫回顧。處理自己的資料時，可以連接 AI 助理，或自行提供文字。

title.en: Can I paste a Facebook or video URL?
title.zh: 可以直接貼 Facebook 或影片網址嗎？

body.en: Remote collectors need their own setup and operator approval. They currently have synthetic tests, with real-account LIVE validation pending. Start with local files.
body.zh: 遠端收集需要各自的設定與操作者授權。目前已有合成資料測試，真實帳號 LIVE 驗證仍待完成。建議先從本地檔案開始。

body.en: This page introduces a tool you install on your computer. Use it through a terminal or connect it to your AI assistant. The example below shows you how to start.
body.zh: 這裡是介紹頁。先把工具安裝在你的電腦上，再透過終端機或已連接的 AI 助理操作。下方的範例會帶你開始。

title.zh: 打開你的第一份有來源回顧。

intro.en: Install uv, then run these two commands to try the alpha. Installation downloads Python and dependencies; the demo needs no account or AI service.
intro.zh: 先安裝 uv，再執行這兩行指令，就能試用 alpha 版。安裝會下載 Python 與依賴；範例不需要帳號或 AI 服務。

body.en: uv downloads the alpha package from PyPI and creates an isolated environment for the command.
body.zh: uv 會從 PyPI 下載 alpha 套件，並為指令建立獨立的安裝環境。

body.en: Import synthetic comments, find the subtitle request, and export Markdown. Open the .md files in the printed Export directory. Each run keeps a new local workspace.
body.zh: 匯入合成留言、找到字幕需求並匯出 Markdown。打開終端機顯示的 Export directory 裡的 .md 檔。每次執行都保留獨立的本地工作區。

title.en: Find the original. Keep a draft you can check.
title.zh: 找到原文，留下能核對的草稿。

intro.en: Start with local files to search, save drafts and export. The fixes in 0.1.0a2 were tested in bounded real Muse and Page-post receipt journeys across candidate builds. Facebook collection and remote media are not yet verified with real accounts.
intro.zh: 先用本地檔案搜尋、保存草稿與匯出。0.1.0a2 包含已完成有界真實 Muse 測試與粉專貼文對帳的修正；測試過程曾更換修正版。Facebook 收集與遠端影音尚未完成真實帳號驗收。

works_title.zh: 用自己的檔案就能開始

limits_title.en: Connect an account to use these workflows
limits_title.zh: 接上帳號，就能使用的流程

works.en:
Import saved comments and subtitles
Bring together the saved comments, articles and subtitle files you already have, so you can find them later.
works.zh:
整理手邊的留言與字幕
把已匯出的留言、文章和字幕放進同一個專案，之後方便查找。

works.en:
Find a comment or transcript passage
Search for a word such as subtitles, then read the matching text and its source.
works.zh:
找出想引用的留言或字幕段落
例如搜尋「字幕」，找到相關留言，再打開原文與來源核對。

works.en:
Keep a draft with its sources
Save text you or your assistant wrote, together with the original material you cited.
works.zh:
保存附來源的草稿
把你或 AI 助理寫好的文字連同引用保存，之後仍能對照原文。

works.en:
Export a file you can edit
Keep your draft and material as text documents or spreadsheet-friendly files for further editing.
works.zh:
匯出能繼續編輯的文件
把草稿與資料匯出成文字文件或試算表可讀的檔案，留在電腦上繼續編輯。

works.en:
Work with your AI assistant
Connect your assistant to MetaMuse, then ask it to find material and draft a recap with citations.
works.zh:
讓慣用的 AI 助理幫忙整理
先接上你慣用的 AI 助理，再請它搜尋資料、整理需求，寫一份附來源的回顧。

availability.zh: 先連接你的 AI 助理

limits.en:
Ask Muse follow-up questions
Select material, ask a question, then follow up in the same conversation. Two real Muse turns and cited draft exports succeeded across candidate builds; use 0.1.0a2 or later for those fixes. Setup and steps.
limits.zh:
把選好的資料拿去問 Muse
選好資料問問題，在同一個對話繼續追問，再保存有引用的草稿。修正版已完成真實 Muse 兩輪問答與匯出；測試過程曾更換修正版，請使用包含修正的 0.1.0a2 或後續版本。連線與操作步驟。

limits.en:
Collect a Facebook post or remote video
Collect one specified post and its comments, or video metadata and available subtitles. Review the exact target and approve the read first. Real-account acceptance is pending. Setup and steps.
limits.zh:
收集 Facebook 貼文或遠端影片
指定一篇貼文收集原文與留言，或取得影片資訊與可用字幕。先看網址與讀取範圍，批准後再執行。真實帳號驗收仍待完成。連線與操作步驟。

availability.en: Needs extra setup; real-account use is unverified
availability.zh: 需額外設定，尚未驗證真實使用

limits.en:
Publish a text post to a Facebook Page
Connect your Page, review the full draft and destination, then approve one send. One real test post and read-only reconciliation succeeded across corrected candidate builds; Use 0.1.0a2 or later for the read-back fix. Setup and limits.
limits.zh:
把文字草稿發到 Facebook 粉專
接上粉專，核對全文與目的地，再批准送出。一篇真實測試貼文已完成只讀對帳，重啟後仍只有一次發文嘗試；測試過程曾更換修正版，請使用包含讀回修正的 0.1.0a2 或後續版本。設定與限制。

heading.en: From your files to a sourced draft
heading.zh: 從你的資料，走到有來源的草稿

intro.en: Bring a comment export or local subtitles. Find the passages you need, write with your assistant, then keep the draft and its sources together.
intro.zh: 帶入留言匯出檔或本地字幕，找出需要的原文，和 AI 助理一起寫，再把草稿與引用一起留下。

note.en: Posts and comments you may use.
note.zh: 你有權使用的貼文與留言。
本地 SRT 或 VTT 檔案。

note.en: Search words and keep exact sources.
note.zh: 用關鍵字搜尋，保留原文與來源。

note.en: Your connected assistant helps you write.
note.zh: 讓已連接的 AI 助理判讀與撰寫。

note.en: Review and export Markdown or text.
note.zh: 預覽後匯出 Markdown 或文字。

ticks.en: Keep a draft you can review
ticks.zh: 留下可以回頭核對的草稿

caption.en: Workflow illustration. Writing uses your own assistant; the local demo uses a prewritten recap and makes no AI call.
caption.zh: 流程示意。撰寫使用你自己的 AI 助理；本地範例使用預寫回顧，沒有呼叫 AI。

heading.en: Read it first. Then approve the post.
heading.zh: 先看全文與粉專，再決定要不要發

intro.en: If you want to publish, MetaMuse prepares the exact text and destination for your review. You approve that post before anything is sent.
intro.zh: 想把草稿發到 Facebook 粉專時，先看這次要送出的全文與目的地。由你核對並批准，才會送出。

note.en: Use the saved text you want to post.
note.zh: 選好這次要發布的草稿版本。

note.en: Check the full text and destination.
note.zh: 看清楚送出全文與目標粉專。
批准只涵蓋這次核對的內容。

note.en: Check the receipt; reconcile unclear results.
note.zh: 保存貼文回執，結果不明先查核。

caption.en: Requires your Page connection and token. One authorized real test post and read-only receipt reconciliation succeeded across corrected candidate builds. Use 0.1.0a2 or later for the read-back fix; uncertain results never resend.
caption.zh: 需要先設定你的粉專連線與權杖。一篇獲准的真實測試貼文已完成只讀對帳；測試過程曾更換修正版，請使用包含讀回修正的 0.1.0a2 或後續版本。送達不明時不重送。
